main.description: Queue a job that applies pending contributions from auto-accept accounts to the catalogue, oldest first. Admins sweep every auto-accept account; an auto-accept account can sweep only its own contributions. Only one sweep per account runs at a time.

limit.description: How many pending contributions the job looks at.

after.description: Resume from this cursor. Use the `after` a previous sweep reported.

writes.description: full writes the game, a verification and a review. minimal writes the game and the review, which is what marks the contribution as no longer pending.

dryRun.description: Report what would be applied without writing anything.

alreadyQueued.description: True when a sweep for the same account was already pending or running; jobId is that sweep.
